segments.name: Payments Platform

revenueModel.text: Consumers and merchants pay the company for products, services, financing and advertising offered through its two-sided Super App platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: offer secure and reliable platforms for all participants and balance the interests of these participants, including consumers, merchants, service providers and others

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired a controlling stake in Turkish e-commerce company Hepsiburada, its first major international expansion.
changes.evidence: On 29 January 2025, the Group acquired 65.41 % share in "D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading" ("Hepsiburada") JSC with the consideration of approximately USD 1,127 million
